| αἰολοθώρηξ (Μενέσθιος αἰολοθώρηξ, 16.173) | "of the glancing breastplate" | "of the glancing breastplate" | "with a flashing corslet", "mail-clad", "of the shifting mail"; αἰόλος keeps "glancing" (σάκος αἰόλον, 7.222) and θώρηξ "breastplate" (3.332) |

| ἰωή (πυρὸς δηΐοιο ἰωήν, 16.127, with λεύσσω "I see") | "the roar" | "the roar" | "the rush", "the blast", "the cry"; the note says ἰωή is a sound and "see the roar" is loose |
